item.title: K8S External Service Integration Practice: Manual Endpoints Mapping External MySQL with WordPress End-to-End Linkage
item.description: A hands-on guide to integrating external stateful services into Kubernetes: using a selector-less Service paired with manual Endpoints to integrate a standalone host MySQL instance into the cluster, deploying a 3-replica WordPress with dynamic Host injection to fix NodePort access, and verifying full end-to-end read/write workflows from MetalLB to the external database.

item.title: K8S Service Types and External Traffic Access: MetalLB Practice, Endpoints Mapping, and NodePort Range Customization
item.description: A comprehensive overview of Kubernetes four Service types and use cases, hands-on practice deploying MetalLB in on-premise clusters for LoadBalancer virtual IPs and fixed NodePorts, comparison between ExternalName and manual Endpoints for routing external services, and customizing apiserver static Pod parameters to extend the NodePort port range.
